occurrences.text: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.
One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;
In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
